title: FACTOR_ENFUSE (c5rl): U zip = F1s′ + RFX (1 : 1) and ENFUSE zip (English = F1s′ Bangla fuser on the English trials + RFX)
role: Stored score = -logit (CodaBench: lower = same person). U: every file = (-logit RFX) + (-logit F1s′), pair by pair, in the pair order of the F1s′ zip, '%.8f' (XTEAM-03/run.py). ENFUSE: Bangla files = bytes of U; English files = -s + (-logit RFX), s = F1s′ Bangla fuser (logistic regression on [Z, C, Z x C]; Z = b3[:, :4], t3[:, 0:2] of components_eval.npz and trCA of ct01r2_final_eval.npz; C = co) applied to the English trials (ENFUSE-U/run.py). posteval_FACTOR_ENFUSE_c5rl.zip gives three of the four files of the 13.54 zip: no_gender Bangla byte for byte, and both English files before the DP blend (stage final_blend in 80_final). The one-step release/factor_enfuse/rebuild_final.py must agree with the chain (asserted).

compute.needs: bash, python with numpy, pandas, scipy (check_eval_zip.py); no pip install

origin.executed: 2026-11-13 12:00 (UTC+7) on the team machine: kaggle/rfx_chain.sh state 3 (log original/rfx_chain_2026-11-13.log)

inputs.use: -logit F1s' of every pair (Bangla of U), the F1s' Bangla fuser JSON and trCA (English of ENFUSE)
the 6 other streams (b3[:, :4], t3[:, :2]), the 7 conditions and pair ids of the English trials
-logit RFX of every pair (original LoRA C1 artifact)

assemble_inputs.note: FF_MODE=assemble (or a missing kernel output): the stage looks for the six files under their flat names in the mounted inputs, then in FF_DATA/05_scores (each FF_DATA root, os.pathsep-separated), then FF_SCORES

main_files.posteval_FACTOR_U_c5rl.zip: U zip (top level of the stage's /kaggle/working)
main_files.posteval_FACTOR_ENFUSE_c5rl.zip: ENFUSE zip (top level): input of final_blend (80_final) and of the BEST4 reference
main_files.a_factor_report.json: inputs (sha256, source), member comparison, Spearman vs reference when available
main_files.rebuild_in/: the six inputs under their flat names (= the FF_DATA/05_scores set of DESIGN 5.3 for these files)
main_files.tree/: the repository-layout working copy (scripts, inputs, outputs)
